title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-maya-2026-03-04
content:
Daily triage scratchpad - quick hits and TODOs

2026-03-04 morning check-in (Maya)
- Quick context: multiple dashboard rendering issues reported after last console deploy (2026-03-03 22:10 UTC). Some widgets show "empty state" / JS error, others time out.
- Customer report: ACME corp (acct: acme-enterprise) saw 503s on "Model Utilization" dashboard at ~00:15 UTC (JIRA OPS ticket created: JIRA-OPS-4823).

Top priority items
1) Repro + scope (TODO: me, assign Jordan)
   - Steps I took: loaded Model Utilization, flipped time range to 7d -> 5m granularity -> UI hangs, browser console: TypeError at dashboard-renderer.js:245
   - Works ok when I switch to "All Regions" vs specific region filter (suspect region-filtering path regression).
   - Repro on prod and staging (staging forwarded to older deploy) -> reproduced on prod only.
   - Next: capture HAR, attach to JIRA, grab full client-side stacktrace. Jordan to open a browserstack session and capture network.

2) Server errors / logs (TODO: Chris)
   - Looked at API gateway logs around 00:10-00:20 UTC: several 500s coming from /dash/v1/render with error "kv-cache lookup failed" on gpu-03 nodes.
   - Suspect: rollout to new serving-runtime (v1.4.2) included a KV cache key name change. Need to confirm with runtime team. Chris to ping eng-serving-runtime on Slack and post recent commit/PR.

3) Temporary mitigation (short-term)
   - Add a fallback in dashboard renderer: if region-filter query returns empty or errors, show stale cached data instead of blank. Low-risk patch -> can ship as hotfix rollback candidate. Status: drafted patch in branches/obs-hotfix-2026-03-04 by me.

4) Customer comms (ACME)
   - CS already sent initial ack, told ACME we are investigating. Need a short update: "We identified a regression in region-filtering that can cause dashboards to fail; engineering is investigating and we expect a fix or mitigation within 3-4 hours." Jordan to send by EOD.

5) Postmortem notes (capture now for later)
   - Timeline: deploy 22:10 UTC -> errors start ~00:10 UTC -> first customer report 00:15 -> ops triage 00:40 -> mitigation patch drafted 01:20
   - Suspected root cause: runtime change in KV cache naming + console code that assumes old name -> unhandled exception in renderer.
   - Action items: add stronger error handling in renderer, add unit/integration tests for region-filtering path, ensure runtime deploys have backward-compatible config during rollout.

Other lower-priority items / follow-ups
- Dashboard threshold alert spams: SLO-alert-129 triggered 6x overnight. Need to tune alert sensitivity or add aggregation to avoid pager fatigue. (add to backlog)
- Investigate embedding-heatmap missing legend: probably CSS regression from chrome 113 -> check recent CSS changes in console repo. (assigned to UX/frontend rotation next week)
- Add automated smoke test for top-5 customer dashboards after each deploy (proposal in CONFLUENCE-obs-dashboards).

Notes to self / loose thoughts
- If this is KV key name change, consider a rolling migration with dual-write for 24h to avoid breakage. Put idea in PR description.
- Keep an eye on cost/billing spikes while we roll back caching (could increase token usage).
- Remind runtime team to include migration notes in release notes (we missed that for v1.4.2).

Immediate TODOs (short list)
- [ ] Capture HAR + console logs and attach to JIRA-OPS-4823 (Maya)
- [ ] Ping eng-serving-runtime channel with suspected KV key change + link to error logs (Chris)
- [ ] Draft customer update for ACME and post to CS ticket (Jordan)
- [ ] Open PR for fallback renderer hotfix and request quick review from frontend oncall (Maya)
- [ ] Add smoke test checklist item to release pipeline doc (follow-up this afternoon)

Slack traces / links
- slack:#console-observability -> thread pinned "deploy v1.4.2 issues"
- PR to check: github.com/redwood/console/pull/4125 (rendering region filter refactor)

End of scratchpad for now. Will update after HARs and logs attached.

---
Notes: keep this doc informal. Move final TL;DR + postmortem to CONFLUENCE-obs-dashboards when stable.
